verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes cap table management, fundraising modeling, SAFEs, 409A valuations, and a Term Sheet Scanner that summarizes potential problems. None of it documents a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The Term Sheet Scanner is an adjacent automated-analysis feature, not an assistant that accepts delegated work, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
